events.title: Tupac Shakur Remembered
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture is still undeniable. What's your go-to track from a true icon?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Remembered
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix – a true guitar god who redefined rock music. What's the riff that still blows your mind?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969, featuring classics like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles walked across that zebra crossing. 'Abbey Road' – still sounding as fresh as ever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-out
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and a British music legend.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful and timeless album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Lennon's Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. An album that still resonates profoundly today.

events.title: First iPod Released 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Tech That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod dropped 25 years ago, changing music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's their most iconic moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of John Lennon. His legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us so many laughs. Happy 87th birthday to a true comedy genius!

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Power
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost an icon. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen performance?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped 61 years ago. A game-changer then, a classic now.

events.title: John Lennon Remembered
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy Lives On
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace resonate as strongly as ever.
